title: Meet Tally in the Gardens

slides.title: Meet Tally
slides.text: This is Tally the cat. Tally looks after the Gardens.

slides.title: The Gardens are quiet
slides.text: The Gardens have gone quiet. Nobody is counting the flowers.

slides.title: We count to find out
slides.text: We count to find how many. Count along with Tally.

slides.title: Who is giggling?
slides.text: Something giggles in the bushes. It is the Jumble, mixing things up.

slides.title: You can help
slides.text: Help Tally wake the Gardens. Count, and the flowers open.

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: There is no game this time. Find the first garden on the path.

talk: What is something you like to count?
